title: Manual Claim Closure & Section Closure
walkthroughSteps: Source: partly epic BMPCC-14434 (Close Claim behaviour follows BMPCC-16284). Land on /claims/CLM-2024-001/overview: status chip reads 'Open'

walkthroughSteps.title: Close Claim
walkthroughSteps.body: Always clickable (superseded the older disabled/tooltip behavior, see CHAMP-PRECLOSURE-CHECKLIST). With blockers present it opens on a Blockers step; with none, it skips straight to the checklist.

walkthroughSteps.title: Pre-closure Checklist
walkthroughSteps.body: 10 system-validated rows must all pass: open tasks, sections, payments, bills, recovery potential, recovery case, recoveries & deductibles, reserves, litigation, reports.

walkthroughSteps.title: Closure reason
walkthroughSteps.body: Required. Continue stays disabled until a reason is picked; leaving the field empty shows 'Closure reason is required.'

walkthroughSteps: Continue through Retention → Confirmation → 'Yes: Close Claim': the overview status chip updates to 'Closed', a closure panel appears below the header with date/reason/handler, and the Close Claim button disappears from the right-strip
Reload the page: closed state persists via sessionStorage hydration, no flash of 'Open' before it settles

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Close Claim opens the Blockers step when any task is still open
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
Source: partly epic BMPCC-14434, Close Claim behaviour from BMPCC-16284.

**Close Claim** is always clickable. When any task is still open, the popup opens at **Close Claim: Blockers** and lists *5 open tasks (...) must be completed, cancelled or deferred*. The footer has only **Cancel**, so the claim cannot be closed from here.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: With no blockers the popup opens at the checklist; the reason is required
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
When nothing blocks, **Close Claim** opens the popup at **Close Claim: Pre-closure Checklist** with every row green. **Continue** leads to **Close Claim: Reason & Retention**, where Continue stays disabled until a **Closure reason** is picked; leaving it empty shows *Closure reason is required.*

**NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** BMPCC-14434 lists 3 closure reasons: "Claim Finalised / Claim Not Pursued / Claim Rejected (OE-configurable)". The dropdown offers only Claim Finalised and Claim Not Pursued. The screen differs from Jira, pending product sign-off.
